question: Should this issue stay blocked on redacted live Discord+MiMo payload proof before repair, or should maintainers sponsor a conservative hardening pass now?
rationale: Current source already gates reasoning-off delivery, and the report is security-sensitive enough that choosing a provider, runtime, or Discord-layer fix without payload proof risks either missing the leak or suppressing legitimate user-visible text.

options.title: Require payload proof first
options.body: Keep the item open and require redacted provider delta, transcript, session state, and outbound Discord payload evidence before choosing a fix boundary.

options.title: Sponsor provider/runtime hardening now
options.body: Have an owner investigate MiMo-compatible reasoning normalization proactively, accepting that the first patch may still need live proof before merge.

options.title: Close as already guarded
options.body: Close based on current source gates, accepting the risk that the user's latest-release Discord path remains unverified.

recommendation.title: Require payload proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the item open and require redacted provider delta, transcript, session state, and outbound Discord payload evidence before choosing a fix boundary.
